brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: edit.get_element_template
objective.description: Return the embedded template for one supported Brique element kind.

#root.role: Resolve one supported element kind against the embedded template set and return the parsed template payload.

item_type._comment: Required. Supported values: context, capacity, matter, structure, schema, document, message, intention, response.

include_raw._comment: Optional, default false. When true, also return descriptor_json (and dsl_reference_json for item_type=capacity): the raw source JSON string preserving original key order. Only needed when the caller intends to reproduce that exact key order in a later write (e.g. via content_json on edit.create). Omit for read-only inspection to avoid paying for a duplicate payload.

template._comment: Parsed template descriptor as a structured object.

descriptor_json._comment: Present only when include_raw is true. Raw template JSON preserving original key order.

effects.embedded_templates: One embedded template document is read from the engine template set.

transformation_contract.morphing: A supported element-kind request becomes the corresponding parsed template descriptor exposed as a structured contract payload.
invariants: Template resolution is read-only and uses the embedded engine template set.
Only the explicitly supported item_type values can be resolved.
descriptor_json (and dsl_reference_json) are only included when include_raw is true; the parsed template/dsl_reference objects are always returned.
success: On success, edit.get_element_template returns the normalized element_kind and the parsed template object; descriptor_json is included only when include_raw was requested.
Template retrieval succeeds without mutating local context state.
failure: The capacity fails when params.item_type is missing or unsupported.
The capacity fails when the corresponding embedded template cannot be loaded or parsed.
notes: This capability is a template lookup helper for editors and generators.
Consumers requiring template source order must pass include_raw=true and parse descriptor_json; template remains the structured compatibility representation and is cheaper when order does not matter.
